title: PILLAGERS HAVE ROLES YOU CAN READ
why: His yes to suggestion 21, pillager roles, and his request for pillagers in more distinct colours. Every pillager now has a role worked out from what he carries (no random number is spent): a RUSHER (shotgun, some SMGs) wears red with shoulder spikes and closes in nearer than he used to; a FLANKER (carbine, some SMGs and rifles) wears green with a streaming scarf; a SUPPRESSOR (Support MG, some SMGs) wears amber with a bandolier and an ammo box; a MARKSMAN (Magnum, Marksman Rifle, Longshot, Whisper, Lance, some rifles) wears blue with a pointed hood, holds his full range and backs off sooner; and anyone in a heavy rig is a SHIELD carrier in violet with a plate on his arm. Half of each coat is the role colour, so a crew reads as different people at a glance, and no words are used. Hired men and friends keep their team look. The medic who revives mates is not in this build.
now: Pillagers now read by role: red rushers close in, blue marksmen hold range, green flankers, amber suppressors, violet shield carriers.
